chapter: Trombone technique, plunger mute and the California years
title: Jabbo Smith's songs, the Hopkins band and Newport
summary: He and Jabbo were close friends in the Claude Hopkins band; he wants Jabbo's songs played and paid for, and discusses the Newport lineup.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: You and Jabbo worked together in Claude Hopkins' band.
Yes. We were pretty tight friends, you know. Yeah, Jabbo has written several good numbers, and no one has ever tried to do them. I did a couple of them.

Yeah, that's a good one. I wanted to put them in several bands, his numbers. I never can get with the guys to get the songs to them, you know. I will, though, eventually. But I think he deserves to get some money for them songs he's written. And the songs are just going to waste, and nobody is making no money off of them -- and I think he should.
He is going to be at Newport this year. Did you know that?

Yes, I know that. He and Bobby Hackett are on the same bill. I don't know for sure if I'm going to be on it. I expected to be on it. But if that's the way they want it, that's their thing, you know? [SHORT LAUGH] Ain't nothin' to me.
Yeah, I don't... I saw... Barney is on it, I think; Barney Bigard.
But I don't know whether that's everybody, or just a few names.
I don't know. I haven't heard anything. The only thing I know is that I'm going to Nice -- or supposedly, you know. So I just don't know...
